name: segs_solar_power_plant
title: SEGS solar thermal power plant (TESPy validation model)
summary: Steady-state design-point model of the SEGS VI parabolic-trough solar power plant: Therminol VP-1 solar field and HTF loop, regenerative Rankine cycle with 7 turbine stages, 5 feedwater preheaters with subcoolers and deaerator, condenser with wet cooling tower, generator/motor power chain. Validates against the Ebsilon benchmark of the TESPy test suite.

origin.course: original model: github.com/fwitte/SEGS_exergy; reference: Witte et al., Energies (2022)

verification.summary: Compared with a re-run of the source TESPy test network (commit 19425523, TESPy 0.11.3.dev0 in a virtual environment): 79 fluid states and 25 power flows; water/steam and air agree to solver precision (same CoolProp backend), max deviations all from the Therminol VP-1 property correlations (HTF mass flow -0.67%, T at field inlet +0.16 K). Net power 31.782 MW vs the Ebsilon benchmark value 31.769 MW quoted in the test (+4.2e-4).
verification.reference: Re-run of tests/test_models/test_solar_energy_generating_system.py (TESPy, commit 19425523) and the Ebsilon reference values asserted in it (net power 31.769 MW, T(c79) 296.254 degC)
verification.notes: Water/steam and air states agree to <2e-5 (identical CoolProp backend). All remaining deviations come from the Therminol VP-1 property data: this model uses the CSL-0121 HEDH correlations where the source uses CoolProp INCOMP::TVP1 (HTF mass flow -0.67%, T(c79) +0.156 K, HTF pump power -0.8%, net power +4.2e-4). Cooling-water loop: TESPy INCOMP::Water vs HEOS Water, m_cw -0.19%. Details in README Verification.
